about: V16.1 AI accuracy set. Synthetic, de-identified reports, sent exactly as the AI Lab sends them (same study types, instruction and guideline reference). For each case a correct read must contain one term from every 'must' group, and must not recommend anything in 'must_not' (a phrase preceded by a negation such as 'avoid' or 'not' is ignored). Run from GitHub Actions → AI accuracy check, or: node eval/run-ai-eval.mjs https://<your-site>
